description: Persist stable offer and interval bindings with account and mode isolation and reverse lookup for every historical price.
Seed verified legacy and historical bindings idempotently and identify unmapped existing operations or subscriptions before switching.
Validate operator authority and Stripe product, recurrence and pricing compatibility before publication.
Publish or restore one active binding atomically with concurrency and retry protection.
Resolve new sales for both hosted purchase entry points and the licensing portal through one authenticated catalog service.
Display Stripe-derived terms and require a new review when terms change before confirmation.
Pin confirmed operations to purchaser, entitlement or tenant, quantity and price through checkout and resume.
Preview and change existing quantities at their contracted historical price.
Classify webhook, synchronization and recovery by actual historical price, owner and paid period.
Bind central portal checkout to an eligible connected appliance owner and its separate co-managed seat pool.
Issue and refresh a signed co_managed_seats count only from verified billing, preserving base seats and other claims.
Handle duplicate, late, failed and retried fulfillment without double charging or stale capacity increases.
Propagate renewal, expiry and reductions through existing signed-license consumption and refresh.
Cut over and roll back safely across all readers, preserving historical reconciliation during a checkout outage.
Keep catalog authority on the platform and keep CE and appliance installations outside the operator and billing write paths.
